about.title: ECHO/trace
about.tagline: Ukukhangisa kobandlululo akwenzi ulimi olusha. Aluthola njalo olusakofuthi.
about.lead: I-ECHO/trace iyinhlelo yokubona izinhlelo ezizimele esebenzisa ubuchwepheshe be-AI ebonisa lolu thola ngesikhathi sangempela. Njalo ngehora lesithupha, isusa izindaba zamazwe anobandlululo angaphezu kwama-30, ihlonza izinhlelo zomlabalaba kusetshenziswa itheksomonomi yama-trope angu-22, futhi iqhathanisa nazo ne-akhivi ekhethiwe yezingcaphuno eziyi-88 ezibalulekile ngokomlando ezivela kumakhosi angaphezu kwama-30 ebandakanya uhulumeni wobandlululo wekhulu lamashumi amabili kanye nekhulu lamashumi amabili nanye.
about.output: Umphumela: iziqhathaniso zabobunikazi ezibeka ukukhangisa kwanamuhla phambi kwabahleli baso basemlandweni — usokhulumela kaPutin okhala njalo uGoebbels, izindaba zikahulumeni waseChina eziphinda iStalin, ukusasaza kwase-Iran okulingisa uMussolini.
about.mechanism: Inhlelo isebenza njengesokulimba kwedijithali, ihlaziya ingkalo ngazo zonke zezinhlangothi ezingu-18 ezikhona kwimfundo yokukhangisa, i-semiotiki nokucwaninga ukuvimbela ukubulawa kwabantu. Ifuna izifaniso ze-DNA ezakhiwe ku-akhivi efika kusukela eJalimane le-Nazi nase-USSR kaStalin kuya eChile likaPinochet, eLibiya kaGaddafi, eNingizimu Afrika yohlelo lwangaphakathi kanye nezinduna zamasosha eLatin America — kusetshenziswa ukusesha okunengqondo nge-vector ukuze kufaniswe ngokwezezwi noma yiliphi uhulumeni noma isikhathi.

comparisons.title: Amazwi Aphindaphindwa Okukhangisa
comparisons.subtitle: Ukuqhathaniswa kwesamayotiksi yobunikazi okuvuselelwa njalo phakathi kwezindaba zikahulumeni zanamuhla nomlabalaba wobandlululo basemlandweni.
